dct_title_s: Alaska : to accompany the Annual Report of the Governor, 1915
dct_description_sm: engraved and printed by the U.S. Geological Survey.
Relief shown by hachures and spot heights.
Includes inset of Aleutian Islands, and list of "radio stations from U.S. Signal Corps."
Shows national forest, boundaries of bird reservations, and miscellaneous government reservations.
